name: ScoreGauge
intent: Radial score dial — a ring whose filled arc is the score, with the figure centred inside it. Use for a single headline index (health score, readiness, compliance), not for a distribution: a donut of several categories is a pie chart, and belongs in a `TrendChart`.

lineage.authoredBy: Group C of the missing-widgets template review (2026-08-26)
lineage.confidence: unset — intent taken verbatim from the module's own doc comment; contract not yet enumerated
notes: Was exported from @corensystem/coren-ui with no manifest at all, so it did not exist to the builder, to library-index.json, or to any agent selecting components.
Stub by design: the intent is accurate, the data contract is not yet authored.

props.name: value
props.description: The score to plot. Clamped to `0..max`.

props.name: max
props.description: Top of the scale. Defaults to 100.

props.name: tone
props.description: Colour of the filled arc and the score figure.

props.description: All standard HTML attributes are supported.
